label: dcm2bids
description: Convert DICOMs using dcm2bids with a per-protocol JSON config.

fields.label: Session
fields.help: Letters and digits only. Empty = omit the ses-* layer.

fields.label: Config file
fields.help: Required. dcm2bids JSON config mapping series to BIDS entities. Generate a template with dcm2bids_helper.

fields.label: Clean up unmatched files
fields.help: Delete the tmp_dcm2bids/ working dir after conversion. Off keeps the unmatched series for debugging.
